brief.topic: ZAgenticOPN ext candidate runtime/API/test deep read: MCP Agent Mail Rust and Avernet

criteria.question: Identify the canonical runtime command, HTTP/MCP endpoint or test that lets one Agent publish available work and another Agent discover eligible work after a generic activation. Follow source and test references; do not infer from product descriptions.
Identify the exposed API or source/test that gives one Agent exclusive execution authority over a shared work item, including concurrent conflict behavior.
Identify the exposed API or source/test for publishing and reading a structured result containing summary, acceptance, next action, blocker and canonical references across Agents.
Identify the exposed API or source/test for a reviewer Agent to discover, claim, verify and complete an awaiting-review work item without copied Human context.
What exact runtime entrypoint, transport, port, authentication and persistence setup is required for a black-box fixture? Cite README, CLI help, server code or integration harness.
Which source or test defines Agent identity, project/workspace scope, authorization and isolation for shared coordination?
Which executable tests or fixtures can be run at the pinned commit to validate the candidate's coordination behavior and external API?
